cc:Work.dc:title: JordanType paper example
cc:Work.dc:description: Zero-translation diagram of examples/paper.scc and paper.slices. S1 has (0,1) with basis x and (1,0) with basis y; S2 has (1,1) with basis x,y and (2,0) with basis y; S3 has (2,1) with basis z=[x]=[y]. The five arrows between consecutive slices have matrices (1,0)^T, (0,1)^T, [1], [1 1], [1]. Slice dimensions are 2,3,1. Power ranks are 6,3,1,0; there is one Jordan block of each size 1,2,3.
